Topic 3.3: The good life of Jesus Christ

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on The good life of Jesus Christ. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What did he do?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain what The good life of Jesus Christ means in simple pupil language
2. give 3 correct examples of The good life of Jesus Christ from Kenya
3. practise The good life of Jesus Christ in clear steps
4. apply The good life of Jesus Christ in one real-life situation this week

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: THE GOOD LIFE OF JESUS CHRIST
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 3
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
The good life of Jesus Christ helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: THE GOOD LIFE OF JESUS CHRIST
Study The good life of Jesus Christ like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain what The good life of Jesus Christ means in simple pupil language

What this means
In this part you learn to explain what The good life of Jesus Christ means in simple pupil language. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what The good life of Jesus Christ means in simple pupil language.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “The good life of Jesus Christ” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain what The good life of Jesus Christ means in simple pupil language. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Give 3 correct examples of The good life of Jesus Christ from Kenya

What this means
In this part you learn to give 3 correct examples of The good life of Jesus Christ from Kenya. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: give 3 correct examples of The good life of Jesus Christ from Kenya.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to The good life of Jesus Christ in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can give 3 correct examples of The good life of Jesus Christ from Kenya. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Practise The good life of Jesus Christ in clear steps

What this means
In this part you learn to practise The good life of Jesus Christ in clear steps. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practise The good life of Jesus Christ in clear steps.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise The good life of Jesus Christ in clear steps. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Apply The good life of Jesus Christ in one real-life situation this week

What this means
In this part you learn to apply The good life of Jesus Christ in one real-life situation this week. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply The good life of Jesus Christ in one real-life situation this week.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “The good life of Jesus Christ” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply The good life of Jesus Christ in one real-life situation this week. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what The good life of Jesus Christ is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “The good life of Jesus Christ” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: explain what The good life of Jesus Christ means in simple pupil language)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to The good life of Jesus Christ in your own words. (skill: give 3 correct examples of The good life of Jesus Christ from Kenya)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: practise The good life of Jesus Christ in clear steps)

Example 4: Show how “The good life of Jesus Christ” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: apply The good life of Jesus Christ in one real-life situation this week)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach The good life of Jesus Christ to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain what The good life of Jesus Christ means in simple pupil language.
3. Practise this skill: give 3 correct examples of The good life of Jesus Christ from Kenya.
4. Practise this skill: practise The good life of Jesus Christ in clear steps.
5. Make one local Kenya example of The good life of Jesus Christ from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for The good life of Jesus Christ: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 3 learner study The good life of Jesus Christ?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What did he do?
2. how they help people in need neighbour?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what The good life of Jesus Christ means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what The good life of Jesus Christ means in simple pupil language.
5. Be able to: give 3 correct examples of The good life of Jesus Christ from Kenya.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
